## Practices in place by truth tag

In place: 3 of the 8 truth tags have a measured condition, each shown with the share of its measured conditions met.

[![Practices in place by truth tag](./tag-profile.svg)](./tag-profile.svg)

Each dot is the share of that tag's measured conditions that are met. A condition with several tags counts on each of its rows and once in the tally, and a dashed row was not measured, never read as zero. Hollow dots: the earlier run, under the same maturity model fixture-2.
